name: Gifts Ungiven

abilities.text: Search your library for up to four cards with different names and reveal them. Target opponent chooses two of those cards. Put the chosen cards into your graveyard and the rest into your hand. Then shuffle.

notes: The four cards are searched into hand and the two the opponent chooses are then moved to the graveyard, which is the printed net result; `search` shuffles the library itself. The `scoped target-opponent` wrapper is what asks for the target: a family op's `chooser` word raises no target requirement of its own (legal.ts `ownTargetSpecs`), so the opponent is the scoped actor and `chooser: "you"` inside it is that player. "with different names" is not expressible — `Filter` has no card-name field.

issues: Search your library for up to four cards with different names — expected four cards, all with different names — scripted search {filter:{}} count:4 optional:true — 'up to four' is right (exact:!optional, game.ts:1277) but 'with different names' is dropped entirely, so four copies of one card can be fetched and the opponent's split is no longer a real choice — CR 701.19c

Target opponent chooses two of those cards. — expected a targeted opponent makes the choice — scripted scoped {who:'target-opponent'} wrapping choose-objects chooser:'you' — legal.ts:90 does raise an {kind:'opponent'} target for a scoped who, and 'you' inside a scoped block is the scoped actor, so the target and the chooser are both correct — CR 115.1

Put the chosen cards into your graveyard and the rest into your hand. — expected chosen -> graveyard, rest -> hand — scripted chosen-fate chosen->graveyard, other->hand; correct, though all four cards transit your hand first because `search` has no reveal-and-hold destination — CR 400.7
